{1: 'The rising wind begins to tear the fog apart. Visibility climbs from two cables to three, then four, and the outline of the strait slowly emerges from the gray. But as the fog recedes, the waters become no less threatening.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'What returns instead is the clearer sound of cannon fire.'}
{1: 'Both fleets can see each other now, which means their firing accuracy is back to normal.'}
{1: 'The third exchange begins while half the fog still clings to the water.'}
{1: 'Adelyde orders the main fleet forward, hoping to break the stalemate while the enemy flagship remains damaged, anchored, and unable to maneuver freely.'}
{1: "The enemy doesn't retreat."}
{1: 'The destroyers inside the reef belt spring back into action, striking from two different exits in turn and disrupting every measured advance Red attempts.', 7: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1593.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1593.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Red First Officer', 3: "Ma'am, destroyers are attacking the right flank! The third battleship has taken damage to starboard!", 4: '1', 18: '100020395'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Starboard destroyers, return fire and drive them back into the reefs. Main fleet, keep advancing.', 4: '1', 18: '100020396'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1587.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1587.jpg'}
{3: 'Cannon fire rolls across the water without end. Fire and sea collide, sending rings of violent spray across the surface.'}
{3: 'The advance is proving harder than expected.'}
{3: 'Every push costs more than projected. The enemy keeps using the reef belt as cover, slipping in and out under fire and forcing Red to spend ammunition just to keep them contained.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1593.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1593.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Port guns, spread your fire across the western reef exit.', 4: '1', 18: '100020397'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Red First Officer', 3: "Ma'am, that kind of coverage will burn through our ammunition—", 4: '1', 18: '100020398'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Keeping them trapped is the priority. Execute.', 4: '1', 18: '100020399'}
{3: 'The bombardment intensifies. Under the relentless rain of shells, the western exit is finally suppressed.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Red First Officer', 3: "Excellent! Now they can't get out!", 4: '1', 18: '100020400'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: "Don't relax. This isn't over.", 4: '1', 18: '100020401'}
{3: "If she were in her opponent's position, this is exactly when she'd strike."}
{3: "The moment your enemy thinks you're out of options—that's when you strike."}
{3: 'Adelyde turns toward the eastern side of the chart just as her first officer cries out.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Red First Officer', 3: 'What?! The supply ship!', 4: '1', 18: '100020402'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiHuijinNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1587.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1587.jpg'}
{3: "Black smoke is already rising from the rear of Red's formation."}
{3: 'An enemy destroyer has broken out through the eastern passage and come around behind them, pouring the last of its firepower into the supply ship.'}
{3: "Red's escorts respond quickly and disable the destroyer, but the supply ship has taken far worse damage."}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiHuijinNew.prefab'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1593.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1593.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'So they did have one more trick up their sleeve.', 4: '1', 18: '100020403'}
{3: 'Her opponent really did split the destroyers into three groups, leaving the flagship dangerously exposed. Adelyde had guarded against another bluff—and walked straight into the real attack.'}
{3: "They're giving up the western exit to strike from the east."}
{3: "One destroyer for her supply ship. They've traded a smaller asset for a far more valuable one, and the strategic advantage has shifted in their favor."}
{3: "They read the situation perfectly and worked out the supply ship's position from limited intelligence... This student may be even bolder and more perceptive than Adelyde expected."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1582.jpg'}
{3: "Meanwhile, on Gray's side..."}
{3: "By the time news arrives that the enemy supply ship has been disabled, the flooding along your flagship's starboard side still hasn't been fully contained."}
{3: 'Damage-control crews rush between the engine room and the starboard compartments. The casualty count keeps rising, and the situation is getting worse.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1595.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1595.jpg'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'Commandant, the eastern destroyer completed its strike. The western exit is still under heavy fire, and the third destroyer is too damaged to deploy.', 4: '1', 18: '100020404'}
{2: 'How much ammunition do we have left?', 3: '95'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'The flagship is below forty percent.', 4: '1', 18: '100020405'}
{3: 'One more heavy exchange will push that below thirty. At that point, you may not have enough ammunition left to hold your position when the final battle begins.'}
{3: 'You run the numbers in your head, then look out through the porthole.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1587.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1587.jpg'}
{3: "Red's main fleet is still advancing slowly."}
{3: "They're waiting for the stalemate to resolve itself—for your ammunition to run dry, or for the damage to become impossible to contain."}
{3: "You'd make the same choice in their position. With such a clear advantage in numbers, waiting is safer than forcing an attack."}
{3: 'But then why?'}

{3: "The question that's been bothering you since the middle of the battle grows harder to ignore. Red has held the advantage from the beginning. Even after forcing them to spend so much ammunition, their superior numbers remain, and you still can't risk leaving the reef belt."}
{3: "And yet, they've never chosen the fastest way to finish the battle."}
{3: "They act decisively when the situation demands it, but there's something unmistakably human in the way they think through each move."}
{3: "That's why you've had to think three moves ahead throughout the entire battle, never allowing yourself a moment to relax."}
{3: "A system wouldn't fight this way. It would pursue maximum efficiency, not draw you into a prolonged contest of wits."}
{2: "Which means Red isn't being controlled by the system.", 3: '113'}
{3: 'The realization brings an unexpected sense of relief—followed immediately by greater caution.'}
{3: 'A person is far less predictable than any automated opponent.'}
{3: 'The fog is nearly gone, but you may still have one chance. The sailors report that the wind is shifting and a storm may be coming.'}
{3: 'A storm would make the reef belt extremely dangerous, but the open sea carries its own threat: rogue waves.'}

{3: 'No matter how sturdy the flagship is, the materials and shipbuilding methods of this era offer little protection against the full force of the sea. In those conditions, the risk of capsizing rises sharply.'}
{3: 'The storm is both a danger and an opportunity.'}
{2: "You'll have to gamble on it.", 3: '120'}
{3: 'The guns fall silent when the first thunder rolls across the sky.'}
{3: 'Both fleets pull back several nautical miles. Neither side can destroy the other in the current situation, and both know that continuing to waste ammunition serves no purpose.'}

{3: 'Once the cannon fire stops, an eerie silence falls over the sea. Only the dull thud of waves against the hull remains. After more than ten hours of constant tension, everyone finally allows themselves to relax a bit.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1595.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1595.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'Commandant, are we just going to sit here and wait?', 4: '1', 18: '100020406'}
{2: "We're waiting for nature to make its move.", 3: '131'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'Ha. I heard that a lot growing up.', 4: '1', 18: '100020407'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'Anyone raised in a fishing family learns early that the weather decides whether you eat.', 4: '1', 18: '100020408'}
{2: 'You grew up in a fishing family?', 3: '134'}

{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: "That's right. The waters around my hometown were rough, though. Nobody could make much money fishing there, so no one paid the place much attention. Even the maritime patrol rarely came by.", 4: '1', 18: '100020409'}

{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: "That's where I joined the volunteer corps. I started as a trainee sailor, but someone noticed how well I knew the sea and sent me to the naval academy. By the time I graduated, I wasn't an ordinary deckhand anymore.", 4: '1', 18: '100020410'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'When I earned my rank, I thought my family would be proud. I went home in uniform, grinning like a fool—and got a beating instead.', 4: '1', 18: '100020411'}
{2: 'A beating? Why?', 3: '138'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: "They said they couldn't lose another son to the war.", 4: '1', 18: '100020412'}

{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'That was when I learned I had an older brother. He joined the military years before me, and when the alliance split, he ended up on the other side. He never came home.', 4: '1', 18: '100020413'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: "I've fought in all kinds of battles over the years. Sometimes I wonder if we ever crossed paths without knowing it.", 4: '1', 18: '100020414'}
{2: 'Would you still want to see him?', 3: '142'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: "Ha, I don't even remember him. But my parents do.", 4: '1', 18: '100020415'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'The two sides have been divided for decades. My generation barely remembers what came before, but our parents never forgot.', 4: '1', 18: '100020416'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'Still, he had nothing to do with why I enlisted.', 4: '1', 18: '100020417'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: "And I certainly didn't join so I could fight my own people. Who would want that?", 4: '1', 18: '100020418'}
{2: 'Then what was your reason?', 3: '147'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'Pirates.', 4: '1', 18: '100020419'}

{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: "Almost every family back home lived off the sea, so running into pirates was unavoidable. I watched too many fishermen I knew disappear because of them. That's why I decided to join the navy.", 4: '1', 18: '100020420'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: "Anyway, I'm getting off track. I talk too much when I'm nervous.", 4: '1', 18: '100020421'}

{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: "I'll be honest with you. At the start, I didn't think we'd last long. Sorry, soldiers aren't supposed to say things like that. But the gap in strength was enormous.", 4: '1', 18: '100020422'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: "But now, you've made me believe we can do this.", 4: '1', 18: '100020423'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: "Everyone on this side trusts you. If you say we wait, then we'll wait.", 4: '1', 18: '100020424'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1587.jpg'}
{3: 'The dark bank of clouds on the horizon sinks lower. When the first low rumble of thunder rolls across the water, the wind suddenly picks up.'}
{3: 'Adelyde walks to the observation window and studies the sky.'}

{3: "A thunderstorm is closing in. Rough seas will shorten both fleets' effective range and further reduce the larger ships' firepower advantage. For the smaller vessels, however, simply staying afloat will become a challenge."}
{3: "If a rogue wave hits, Red's ships could be in serious trouble."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1593.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1593.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'End this battle before the storm reaches us.', 4: '1', 18: '100020425'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/IconMovie/V480haituNormal01.png'}
{3: "She turns back to the chart table and takes one last look at both fleets' positions."}
{3: 'The enemy flagship is holding the exit with two shell impacts on its hull. Two destroyers have been lost, and their ammunition reserves are likely below fifty percent.'}
{3: 'The advantage is still hers. She only needs one final push.'}
{3: 'Nearly ninety percent of the fog has cleared.'}
{3: 'The entire strait is now visible—the reefs, the width of the main channel, and every position held by the enemy fleet.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1587.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront161.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront13.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1587.jpg'}
{1: 'RImgBg1BlowUp'}
{3: 'Adelyde steps out onto the deck, raises her binoculars, and looks toward the enemy flagship.'}
{3: 'The scarred flagship is still holding the mouth of the main channel, its engines growling in stubborn defiance.'}
{3: 'A lone figure stands at the very front of the deck—the person commanding that battered giant.'}
{3: 'Through her binoculars, Adelyde sees the figure raise a pair of their own.'}
{3: 'Their gazes meet across layers of glass, the vast strait, and the data stream holding the simulation together. For the first time in years, Adelyde feels a chill run through her.'}
{3: "It feels like a revelation striking straight through her soul. She can't put the sensation into words. If her arms were still flesh and blood, every hair would be standing on end."}
{3: "After dozens of hours fighting across the simulated battlefield, this is the first time they've seen even the outline of each other."}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront161.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.3'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront13.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.3'}
{3: 'She lowers the binoculars at once. In the final instant before the view disappears, the student across the water seems to do the same.'}
{3: 'The wind continues to rise.'}
{3: 'When the last of the fog disappears, the final battle will begin.'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront161.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront13.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Narrow'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'Commandant? Did you say something?', 4: '18', 18: '100020426'}
{3: 'You take in the scene before you. The sea is black as ink, streaked with white foam from the breaking waves. A storm is coming, and an uneasy air hangs over the waters.'}
{3: 'From the deck, you can just make out the enemy ship in the distance. Against the roaring chaos of sea and sky, its crimson banner cuts through the gloom like a fresh wound.'}

{3: 'Even more striking is the silver-white hair whipping in the wind before the bridge. Its owner stands at the very front of the enemy vessel like a steady anchor, utterly unmoved by the storm around her.'}
{3: "Her eyes meet yours across the water. You can't see her clearly at this distance, but you understand exactly what she's waiting for."}
{3: 'The rigging shrieks as the waves rise higher and higher. You make a quick call.'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront161.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.5'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront13.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.5'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1582.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1582.jpg'}
{2: "What's the wind doing?", 3: '225'}
{3: 'Your first officer steps out from the formation. His booming report carries cleanly over the howling wind.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'Maximum gusts are up to fifty-two knots! Force Nine gale!', 4: '1', 18: '100020427'}
{3: "Force Nine on the Beaufort scale. The risk of rogue waves has risen sharply. That's the signal. The final battle is about to begin."}
{3: 'A single, unified response rolls across the sea. As the final battle begins, every soldier shouts with everything they have, as though courage alone might persuade fate to spare them.'}
{3: 'Both fleets advance at the same time.'}
{3: 'No signal is needed. Both sides know the long stalemate has reached its end.'}
{3: 'The distance closes. Gunners are in position. Loaders stand ready. Everyone waits for the order to fire.'}
{3: "But the next sound isn't an order. It's the lookout's alarmed shout."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lookout', 3: "Unknown fleet sighted to the northwest! They're closing in fast, and we can't identify their colors!", 4: '18', 18: '100020428'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{3: 'Every eye turns northwest.'}

{3: 'The outlines of sails emerge from the distant haze—one ship, then another. They rush forward like predators finally leaving cover to strike, moving fast in a loose formation unlike any regular navy.'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'Damn vultures. They smelled blood and came running!', 4: '1', 18: '100020429'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'Pirates! Eight galleons and more than a dozen armed merchant ships, bearing down from the northwest!', 4: '1', 18: '100020430'}
